mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_ID -- 게시판ID , TITLE -- 제목 , CONTENT -- 상세내용 , COALESCE(NULLIF(VW_CNT, 0), 0) AS VW_CNT -- 조회수 , BOARD_TYPE -- 게시판유형 , USER_ID -- 작성자 , REG_ID -- 등록자 , TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DATE -- 등록일자 , UPD_ID -- 수정자 , TO_CHAR(UPD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPD_DATE -- 수정일자 FROM WMS.TB_BOARD WHERE 1 = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY BOARD_ID DESC, REG_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO WMS.TB_BOARD AS T USING ( SELECT #{boardId}::INTEGER AS BOARD_ID , #{title} AS TITLE , #{content} AS CONTENT , #{boardType} AS BOARD_TYPE , #{userId} AS USER_ID ) AS S ON (T.BOARD_ID = S.BOARD_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TITLE = S.TITLE , CONTENT = S.CONTENT , UPD_ID = S.USER_ID , UPD_DATE = NOW() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BOARD_ID , TITLE , CONTENT , BOARD_TYPE , USER_ID , REG_ID , REG_DATE) VALUES ( S.BOARD_ID , S.TITLE , S.CONTENT , S.BOARD_TYPE , S.USER_ID , S.USER_ID , NOW())
